clips.title: The story
paras: Thunder Ridge lies southwest of Orgrimmar, where thunder lizards roam a stripped canyon. Along the Southfury River in western Durotar, the former grove was ruined by human logging and dark sorcery. Agitated beasts and lingering cultists threaten nearby settlements.

Thunder Ridge was once a green haven in arid Durotar, shaded by ancient trees. Shortly after the Third War, humans from Kul Tiras began felling its timber. The thunder lizards grew wild as their home was cut away. Then the Burning Blade used fel sorcery to destroy what remained of the canopy. Now the gorge lies barren and exposed, with angry, lightning-spewing beasts roaming through it.
